title: ComplianceReport
description: The frozen, producer-agnostic report contract for pyforge-warden (Warden) (the atlas FR-16/FR-18 gate is this schema's second producer). Closed sets: status.value (7-rung lattice), exit_code {0,1,2,130}, errors[].kind. additionalProperties is deliberately left open everywhere: additive growth (a new axis, KEV/EPSS population, new optional fields) is never a schema break. Finding-ID scheme (stable + deterministic): vuln:<advisory-id>:<pkg>@<ver> | hygiene:<DEP-code>:<module-or-pkg> | indeterminate:<reason>:<pkg> | license:<spdx-or-unknown>:<pkg>@<ver> | currency:<reason>:<subject>@<ver> (Story 6.1 added the last two; currency's reason is a CLOSED 3-value set eol|over-lag|unknown). Waiver-scope decision (recorded): all five finding families are waivable-with-expiry — an auditable, time-boxed acceptance; the graduated path for unscannable deps.

schema_version.description: Core semver of the v1 report contract (no prerelease/build tags; decoupled from the tool version and the SBOM spec version).

value.description: The 7-rung verdict lattice (canonical token is 'warn', not 'warnings').

driver.description: Why the verdict is what it is — an exit that can't say why is an incoherent contract.

status.description: driver must be non-null for every non-clean status; null is permitted only for 'clean' and 'not-applicable' (no finding exists to point at, by definition).

exit_code.description: The frozen, closed exit-code set — adding a code is a breaking change. 130 is the SIGINT signal-path constant, not a lattice rung.

coverage.description: Keyed by the OPEN axis string. Four rows are now always emitted: 'hygiene'/'vulnerability' (assessed by their v1 engines) plus 'license'/'currency' (Story 6.1 registers them as producer axes — always emitted, as honestly not-applicable until their Epic 6 producers land; a further SAST axis would still land additively).

then.description: A concrete max_age_ok verdict (true/false) implies vuln data WAS consulted, so its provenance (source + snapshot_at) must be stated.

vuln_data.description: Vulnerability-data provenance — generic names ONLY (never engine-named fields); nullable when no vuln data was consulted.

inventory_count.description: Post-merge component count; the root project is excluded.

kind.description: Manifest-kind token; the vocabulary is owned by the discovery story (1.9) and is deliberately open here.

suppressions.description: Optional (Story 6.1, additive): findings suppressed by a waiver (origin='waiver') or baseline (origin='baseline'). Story 6.1 populates only the waiver half; absent/[] on a scan with no applied waivers.

license_data.description: Reserved nullable license-feed provenance slot (FR38). Always null in v1: the license axis is metadata-sourced (no remote feed), unlike currency_data/kev_data/epss_data. Populating would require a future license-feed producer.

currency_data.description: Optional currency/endoflife-feed provenance (Story 6.3 populates); null until then.

kev_data.description: Optional CISA-KEV-feed provenance (Story 6.4 populates); null until then.

epss_data.description: Optional EPSS-feed provenance (Story 6.7 populates); null until then.

actuation.description: Optional, reserved open slot for the fix-PR actuator section (Story 6.9 populates); always null in Story 6.1.

then.description: status/exit coherence: error exits 2 (or 130 if interrupted).
status/exit coherence: policy-violation exits 1 (or 130 if interrupted).

status/exit coherence: indeterminate WITH the D2(c) empty-extraction driver (Story 1.9, exact finding_id match) exits 1 by default, 0 under the one sanctioned --allow-empty exception, or 130 if interrupted. Status stays indeterminate, never clean.

status/exit coherence: indeterminate WITHOUT the D2(c) empty-extraction driver exits 1 (or 130 if interrupted) — exit 0 is reserved for that one sanctioned exception (Story 1.9 review pass 2: the exit-0 branch above must not leak to every indeterminate cause).
status/exit coherence: warn exits 0, or 1 under the warn_is_error knob (or 130 if interrupted).
status/exit coherence: the clean family exits 0 (or 130 if interrupted).

finding_id.description: References a findings[].id when the verdict is finding-driven. For operational-error verdicts the driver-ID grammar is owned by the typed-errors story (1.7), so this field is deliberately unconstrained here.

id.description: Stable, deterministic finding ID — one of the families: vuln:<advisory-id>:<pkg>@<ver> | hygiene:<DEP-code>:<module-or-pkg> | indeterminate:<reason>:<pkg> | license:<spdx-or-unknown>:<pkg>@<ver> | currency:<reason>:<subject>@<ver> (reason is a CLOSED 3-value set). Waiver matching across runs depends on it; every family is waivable-with-expiry.

raw.description: Raw evidence: a CVSS vector string or a database severity label.

kev.description: Known-Exploited-Vulnerabilities slot — declared now, populated by Story 6.4.

kev_date.description: CISA-KEV date-added slot — declared now, populated by Story 6.4.

epss.description: EPSS {score, percentile} slot (both probabilities in [0, 1]) — declared now, populated by Story 6.7. The {score, percentile} object shape is a 1.1.0-sanctioned additive narrowing of the former number|null.

license.description: Per-component SPDX license verdict (Story 6.2 populates); no 'source' field — that name is section-level provenance elsewhere.

tier.description: Which rung of the FR34 tier ladder resolved this verdict (NFR-S9 provenance).

currency.description: Per-component currency verdict + tier-ladder provenance (Story 6.3 populates).

then.description: A license: finding is emitted only for denied/unknown (never allowed), and MUST carry the license sub-object (properties is vacuous on an absent key).

Currency-provenance completeness: for an eol/over-lag finding, the currency sub-object MUST be present (required:['currency'] — self-standing, not merely rescued by the verdict-const clause) with latest/lag/eol_date present AND non-null (types narrowed to exclude null, mirroring vuln_data.max_age_ok's if/then).

resolution_depth.description: The resolution-depth honesty claim: 'direct-only' vs 'locked-closure' (null when no claim is made).

gating.description: Whether this axis's gate is active this run (Story 6.1 reserves the slot, default false; config.py is the sole writer — Story 6.2/6.3/6.5 compute it).

axisCoverage.description: Coverage arithmetic (manifests_parsed <= manifests_found; deps_assessed <= deps_total) is enforced at the model layer (AxisCoverage.__post_init__) because JSON Schema cannot cross-compare sibling fields.

suppressedFinding.description: One suppressed finding echoed once (Story 6.1 wires the waiver half; Story 6.8 the baseline half). The discriminator is 'origin', NOT 'source'. authorized_by/expires_at are nullable because baseline entries are bulk-accepted. At-most-one-per-finding_id + finding_id references an existing findings[].id are enforced at the model layer (Draft 2020-12 has no cross-array uniqueness-by-key keyword).

then.description: A concrete max_age_ok verdict (true/false) implies the feed WAS consulted, so its provenance (source + snapshot_at) must be stated — mirrors vuln_data's own if/then.

feedProvenance.description: Per-feed provenance for the license/currency/KEV/EPSS report sections (generic names ONLY), reusing vuln_data's shape + coherence rule.
